title: Generative learning selects experimentally active EGFR inhibitor analogs
summary: A recurrent generative model refined by reinforcement learning selected compounds for an EGFR enzyme assay. Four of 15 predicted-active compounds were active, including two with nanomolar inhibition; five predicted-inactive controls were inactive. The experimentally tested compounds were commercially obtainable analogs of a known privileged scaffold, not a wholly new drug scaffold or demonstrated cellular therapy.
ai_technology: Recurrent neural generator with reinforcement learning
organization: Carnegie Mellon University; University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill; Enamine

evidence.tested: An independent contract assay tested selected compounds and negative controls.
evidence.unknown: Cellular efficacy, selectivity, safety and novel-scaffold discovery are not established.
evidence.ai_role: Recurrent neural generator with reinforcement learning supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Primary publisher PDF abstract, selected experimental Results and affiliations; primary Crossref online-date metadata. Supplement not reviewed.
